Maintenance Planner position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers in all states of Australia through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay with business locations in Queensland, New South Wales and Western Australia.

Our Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Maintenance Planner to join our team, bringing a goal-oriented mindset to ensure minimal disruption to the organisation's assets and projects. This role aims to achieve planned time, cost, and quality metrics for projects, aligning with NEPEAN Conveyor’s policies and procedures. The Maintenance Planner will be responsible for strategising, scheduling, coordinating, and monitoring the maintenance of all plant equipment, infrastructure, and machinery - minimizing downtime, reducing costs, and improving overall operational efficiency

Core responsibilities include however are not limited to:
Planning and Scheduling: Develop and manage detailed maintenance schedules and work orders to ensure timely and cost-efficient maintenance of the organisation’s activities and goals.
Coordination: Work closely with maintenance personnel, engineering teams, and operations to schedule regular preventive maintenance, handle emergencies, and conduct inspections. Ensuring minimal disruption to production or services.
Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance work complies with safety regulations and industry standards.
Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of maintenance performed, equipment condition, and maintenance costs.
Equipment Modifications: Plan and implement equipment modifications and upgrades in collaboration with engineering and operations teams.
Inventory Management: Track the inventory of spare parts and ensure their availability for routine and emergency maintenance.
Problem-Solving: Identify and address potential issues before they become costly problems, and adjust schedules to account for unexpected emergency work.
Reporting: Prepare and present reports on maintenance activities and their effectiveness.

The Right Person
We are interested in hearing from you if you have:
A degree or certificate in a related field such as engineering, industrial maintenance, or facilities management.
Prior experience in facilities maintenance, industrial maintenance, or a similar field.
Strong understanding of maintenance procedures, best practices, and equipment.
Excellent organisational and planning skills to manage schedules and coordinate maintenance activities.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with maintenance personnel, and engineering teams.
Ability to identify and address potential issues proactively.
Familiarity with maintenance management software and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of safety regulations and protocols to ensure compliance during maintenance activities.
Meticulous attention to detail for accurate record-keeping and reporting.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, including various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds

If you're ready for your next challenge, please "Apply Now" and forward through your interest today!
Salary: $130,000 per annum

This is a unique opportunity for an exceptional and visionary General Manager, Data & AI to establish and lead our AI and Data Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACoE) and drive the next phase of our data and digital transformation journey.

Reporting to the Chief Technology & Corporate Services Officer, this pivotal role will shape how data, analytics and artificial intelligence are leveraged across the organisation to improve clinical outcomes, enhance operational performance and support strategic decision-making. You will champion a data-driven culture, helping leaders across our hospitals and services unlock the value of information to deliver better outcomes for patients, employees (caregivers) and the organisation.

Welder/Fabricator – Multiple Permanent Opportunities

Perth, Western Australia | Full-Time | Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources is seeking experienced Welder/Fabricators to join our growing network of leading employers across Perth, Western Australia.

We have multiple long-term opportunities available for skilled tradespeople who take pride in producing high-quality work and want to build a secure and rewarding career with established Australian businesses.

Whether you are already living in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates.

About the Role

As a Welder/Fabricator, you will be involved in the fabrication, assembly and repair of metal components across a range of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.

Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you will be part of a professional team committed to quality workmanship and high safety standards.

Your responsibilities may include:

Manufacturing components and welded assemblies from engineering drawings.
Completing precision fabrication and welding work in accordance with quality requirements.
Working with mechanical and engineering teams to manufacture high-quality products.
Identifying repair requirements and estimating repair times.
Operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment.
Inspecting completed work to ensure it meets the required standards.
Maintaining a clean, organised and safe work area.
About You

To be successful, you will have:

Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade, including MEM30305, MEM31922, MEM30319 or MEM31925, or an equivalent recognised qualification.
A minimum of three to five years’ experience as a Welder/Fabricator or Boilermaker.
Proficiency in FCAW, GMAW and CAC-A (Air Carbon Arc Cutting).
The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans.
The ability to complete welding qualification tests to AS/NZS 1554 SP requirements.
Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment.
Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills.
High attention to detail and pride in producing quality workmanship.
The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Good communication and problem-solving skills.
A strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards.
A reliable attitude and strong work ethic.
The ability to complete a pre-employment medical, drug and alcohol screening, and other required employment checks.
Highly Regarded
Forklift Licence (LF).
Current Australian C Class Driver’s Licence.
Dogging (DG), Basic Rigging (RB) or EWP High Risk Work Licence.
Previous experience within heavy fabrication, mining, manufacturing or industrial environments.
What’s on Offer
Permanent, full-time employment.
Multiple opportunities across Perth, Western Australia.
Competitive salary packages with overtime opportunities.
Long-term career stability with established Australian employers.
Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment.
Ongoing training and career development.
Supportive and safety-focused team environments.
Employer sponsorship opportunities for eligible candidates.
Support for suitably qualified overseas applicants planning to relocate to Australia.
Employer Sponsorship

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine, long-term employment opportunities across Australia.

Employer sponsorship may be available for suitably qualified candidates, subject to employer approval, skills assessment requirements and Australian migration eligibility.

Why Join MYAC Resources?

MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia’s manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors.

We don’t just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Welder/Fabricator looking for your next opportunity in Perth, we would like to hear from you.

Submit your application using the Apply Now button or email your current resume to recruitment@myacresources.com.au.

One of our recruitment specialists will contact shortlisted applicants to discuss available opportunities.

Weldworks is hiring a Full-time Construction Project Manager role in West Ryde, NSW. Apply now to be part of our team.

Requirements for this role:

Flexible hours available
2–3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
WELDWORKS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager for our client’s construction projects, including residential homes, commercial buildings, civil works and public spaces in Sydney.
On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating construction projects, as well as managing the physical, financial and human resources involved in the construction process.

Title: Construction Project Manager, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person
We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:

Requirements
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Construction Project Management, Construction Management, Building Technology, Building Science, Civil Engineering or another highly relevant field. 
•	At least 2–3 years of relevant experience managing residential, commercial, industrial or civil construction projects. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing construction schedules, budgets, labour, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Strong knowledge of construction methods, building legislation, Australian Standards, quality requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Ability to read, assess and interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, specifications and construction contracts. 
•	Experience coordinating architects, engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, tradespeople and relevant authorities. 
•	Strong understanding of tendering, procurement, contract administration and project cost control. 
•	Ability to identify project risks, delays and budget variations and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. 
•	Excellent organisational, reporting and problem-solving abilities. 
•	Current Australian driver licence preferred. 
•	Relevant registration, licence or site accreditation may be required depending on the project and scope of work. 

Construction Project Manager Responsibilities
•	Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate construction projects from commencement through to completion. 
•	Establish project plans, construction schedules, milestones, budgets and resource requirements. 
•	Interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and contractual requirements. 
•	Determine appropriate construction methods, sequencing, labour requirements, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Coordinate the procurement and delivery of construction materials, equipment and services. 
•	Consult with architects, engineers, building professionals, consultants, tradespeople and technical workers. 
•	Negotiate and communicate with building owners, property developers, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. 
•	Prepare, review and contribute to tenders, quotations, contract bids and project proposals. 
•	Implement coordinated work programs across construction sites. 
•	Monitor project progress, expenditure, quality, safety, risk and compliance against approved plans and budgets. 
•	Ensure construction activities comply with relevant building legislation, Australian Standards, contractual requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Manage and monitor the performance, quality and progress of contractors and subcontractors. 
•	Arrange the submission of plans, permits and supporting documents to relevant authorities. 
•	Coordinate required inspections, approvals and project handover activities. 
•	Prepare progress reports, budget updates, risk assessments and project documentation. 
•	Identify potential delays, cost overruns, quality issues and construction risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Lead and supervise site managers, project engineers, supervisors, forepersons, subcontractors and tradespeople as required. 
•	Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders throughout the construction process. 
•	Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with the required quality standards. 

These responsibilities reflect the official ANZSCO functions for Construction Project Managers, including management of construction 
schedules, procurement, contractors, budgets, compliance, inspections and project resources. 
If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position available and determine whether the role is suitable for your qualifications and experience.

Build Tiny Pty Ltd is an innovative Australian manufacturer specialising in the design and construction of premium tiny homes and modular living solutions. Operating from its Campbellfield, VIC manufacturing facility, the company combines skilled craftsmanship, precision engineering and modern construction techniques to deliver high-quality, durable and sustainable homes for customers throughout Australia. 

Due to continued business growth, Build Tiny Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced and trade-qualified Welder (First Class) to join its production team.

Working within a modern manufacturing environment, you will fabricate and weld structural steel and metal components used in the construction of custom-built tiny homes. The successful applicant will be capable of working from engineering drawings, maintaining high quality standards and contributing to efficient production schedules.
This is a full-time position offering long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian manufacturer.

Minimum Requirements

-	Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (or equivalent qualification) 
-	Minimum one-year relevant post-qualification experience as a Welder (First Class) 
-	Demonstrated experience in MIG and TIG welding and general steel fabrication 
-	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
-	Strong understanding of fabrication tolerances and quality control procedures 
-	Commitment to workplace health and safety 

Key Responsibilities

-	Perform high-quality MIG, TIG and other welding processes on structural steel, stainless steel and aluminium components used in tiny home construction. 
-	Fabricate, assemble and weld chassis, structural frames, brackets and other metal components in accordance with engineering drawings and production specifications. 
-	Read and interpret technical drawings, welding symbols and fabrication documentation. 
-	Prepare materials by cutting, grinding, drilling, milling, tapping and shaping steel components prior to fabrication. 
-	Measure, mark and accurately align components using precision measuring equipment. 
-	Inspect welds to ensure structural integrity, penetration, dimensional accuracy and compliance with quality standards. 
-	Complete finishing work including grinding, dressing, polishing and deburring fabricated components. 
-	Assist in fitting fabricated steel assemblies into modular building frames where required. 
-	Operate welding and fabrication equipment safely and efficiently while ensuring machinery is maintained in good working condition.
